title: Control Forward-Backward Consistency: Quantifying the Accuracy of Koopman Control Family Models
summary: This paper extends the forward-backward consistency index, originally introduced in Koopman modeling of systems without input, to the setting of control systems, providing a closed-form computable measure of accuracy for data-driven models associated with the Koopman Control Family (KCF). Building on a forward-backward regression perspective, we introduce the control forward-backward consistency matrix and demonstrate that it possesses several favorable properties.
